name: Cyberheart
source:
Some search for destiny and purpose their entire lives but never find it, for others it can easily just fall into your lap.

For one young man, he has searched long for a purpose in a world where the technology of corporations has taken over. His simple life, despite the friends he has around him, which include a litany of lovely girls, simply does not speak to what he truly wishes for.

Purpose comes knocking when he finds a girl falls into his life, a victim of corporate experimentation. It is up to him and the people around him to do what they can to save this girl from those who would pull her back into a terrible world.

During that fight, the young man may learn of his true purpose, of love…of loss and much more. He will be put to the test, one that he may have asked for…but might never have ever been truly prepared for…and it all begins with a simple question;

[From [url=https://dipeppo.itch.io/cyberheart]Itch[/url]]
translation:
有些人一生都在寻找命运和目标，但从未找到它，而对于另一些人来说，它很容易落入你的怀抱。

对于一个年轻人来说，他长期以来一直在企业技术占据主导地位的世界中寻找目标。尽管他周围有朋友，其中包括一长串可爱的女孩，但他简单的生活根本无法表达他真正的愿望。

当他发现一个女孩闯入了他的生活，成为公司实验的受害者时，他的目标就来了。他和他周围的人有责任尽一切努力将这个女孩从那些会把她拉回可怕世界的人手中拯救出来。

在这场战斗中，年轻人可能会了解到他的真正目的、爱……失去等等。他将接受考验，这是他可能要求的考验……但可能从未真正做好准备……这一切都始于一个简单的问题；

[来自[url=https://dipeppo.itch.io/cyberheart]Itch[/url]]
